purpose: Decorative assets only. All titles, names, values and interactions are live HTML.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap asset for an elegant Chinese interactive narrative game, '此生行记'. Create a richly detailed, beautifully lit vertical illustrated frontispiece, portrait aspect ratio 2:3, no interface and absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, typography or watermark. A sculptural wing made from layered ivory paper and brushed silver filigree rises on the right, its individual feather-like paper leaves resolving into open pages; between those pages a luminous small horizon of clouds and a distant winding route is visible. This is a metaphor for entering an unwritten life, not an actual god, angel character or established geographic place. No face, no human figure, no symbols defining a religion, no medieval castle or specific cultural architecture. Deep midnight indigo and cold graphite shadows, ivory and pearlescent highlights, just one restrained cobalt ribbon of reflected light. An extraordinary fine art illustration with precise engraved edges, delicate graphite linework, translucent paper fibers and soft cinematic volumetric light, printed-engraving meets luxurious game concept art. Dense craft detail at the upper right and lower right; the left third transitions into pale silver-grey air with fewer details to support a code-drawn text panel next to it, but keep all text out of the image. Layered floating fragments of paper form meaningful flowing arcs, never random confetti. Composition should be recognizably authored, asymmetrical and disciplined, a tactile jewel of a book frontispiece. Avoid generic AI fantasy glowing orb, purple and gold gradients, heavy bronze borders, saturated emerald, fog hiding detail, blurry details, stock dashboard appearance. Render usable final game illustration, not a screenshot or a collage of mockups.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a final production illustration for the side/frontispiece of a refined interactive novel encyclopedia named 世诰. Portrait 2:3 composition, no text whatsoever. A monumental open ivory book viewed obliquely, its layered pages unfolding upward into a thin astronomical armillary ring and delicately engraved birds made of folded paper. One long cobalt-blue bookmark drapes naturally through the composition. Brushed silver, frosted glass and carved graphite materials, exquisite restrained craft, engraved lines sharp enough to read as workmanship, natural rough-cut paper edges. A deep midnight background at the right and bottom; pale mist-grey negative space in the upper left. A small soft light source at the book's spine makes the paper luminous and casts precise overlapping shadows. Think fine editorial frontispiece with the dimensional sophistication of a hand-crafted narrative RPG menu, asymmetrical, refined, neither a real-world religious object nor a magic item belonging to a character. No person, no face, no identifiable city or landscape, no text, no glyphs pretending to be text, no watermark, no interface, no logo. We will place actual world title, category and chapter information over separate code panels, so do not prepaint any UI. Keep crisp tactile detail, elegant cool neutral silver/ivory with narrow cobalt accents; avoid loud purple, emerald and bronze, generic glowing orbs, random particles, excessive blur. This asset should feel sumptuous on repeated inspection.

Use case: stylized-concept. Final usable UI illustration, not a mockup. Wide landscape 3:2, a richly crafted EMPTY display surface for the important-item inventory of a literary RPG. A weathered deep graphite desk or shallow circular display dais seen almost from the front, three thin ivory/silver rings inlaid around its base, delicate engraved botanical lines at the lower corners, folded ivory archival paper partially visible at the side, a narrow dark cobalt cloth passing behind the dais. The CENTER must remain completely empty and uncluttered, with a clearly lit central area for us to overlay the player's actual item glyph in code. Do NOT paint a sword, cup, jewel, book, weapon, potion, equipment, human, hand, labels, words or UI. The empty stage is essential: never imply an unearned object exists in the player's inventory. Cinematic side lighting from the upper left, subtly lit dust only on the illuminated edge, hard precise stone and paper textures, understated pearlescent highlights. Background falls to deep cold indigo at the upper corners, not black murk. Give the empty platform remarkable material richness and depth, like a museum specimen stage in an expensive art-directed game. Palette graphite, ivory, brushed silver, restrained cobalt; no gold flood, purple gradient, green glow, neon, repeating faux runes, border frame or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production decorative backing illustration for the top third of three selectable talent contract cards in a richly art-directed literary roleplaying game. Portrait 2:3, no text and no UI. A cold ivory sculpted geometric rosette made of overlapping paper petals, very thin silver orbital rings and one folded midnight-blue ribbon, seen frontally in a narrow high frame. The design should have a sharply crafted center but no glowing orb, no eye, no weapon, no human, no face, no fixed religious icon, no literal stat symbols: actual selectable stat-specific SVG emblems will be layered over the empty central rosette opening by code. Fine engraving along paper folds, silver threads, a low-relief dark graphite backing, delicate worn paper fibers. Top left grazing light makes overlapping leaves cast precise shadows; bottom third falls into dark navy and is comparatively quiet to support a separate light paper text panel below. Sophisticated and jewel-like in detail, excellent visual hierarchy, only ivory, graphite, silver, restrained cobalt. No typography, numbers, letters, logo or watermark. Avoid generic fantasy card pack, ornamental bronze border, purple gradients, emerald glow, random confetti, hazy low detail. A usable unique printed-illustration asset that can be cropped differently for three contract cards without becoming three invented abilities.

Use case: stylized-concept. Final wide landscape 3:2 decorative heraldic illustration for a player character archive header, not a person portrait. Place an exquisite stylized silver raven made from paper-cut and engraving layers on the RIGHT HALF, wings half folded into a fan of ivory pages, facing toward the left. It is a literary visual motif, not a real companion, god, faction, equipment or character. A few very fine botanical engraved branches and long concentric engraved arcs frame the lower right. One narrow flowing cobalt ribbon runs behind the bird. The LEFT HALF is deep muted midnight indigo and graphite, smooth and quiet, suitable for overlaying code-rendered player identity in white; no painted text. Cinematic light from above right, pearlescent feather edges, tactile dark paper, crisp linework, controlled subtle shadows, carefully authored asymmetry. This should match a sophisticated narrative game's silver-paper and cold-ink visual identity. No human face or gender, no religion, no crest implying a real allegiance, no gold or purple flood, no green mist, no stock magic orb, no glowing runes, no UI, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logo or watermark. The illustration must remain rich at close inspection yet legible behind an actual player's name on the empty left.
